observations.behavior: The Slack app now sends thread-join requests to the thread creator's DM instead of an ephemeral message in the thread, and the joiner sees the request in the thread. A permalink to the thread is generated and included in the request. The mode resolution no longer distinguishes between billing to the creator's own plan and billing to PostHog credits; both cases now resolve to ALLOW.
observations.code_quote: # A DM notifies the creator. An ephemeral message in the thread does not, so they often miss it.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent the thread creator from missing a request to join their thread, potentially improving the reliability of the Slack app's thread-join workflow.
